I wrote `component.html` in the folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It follows the v4 Screens rules in `DESIGN.md`:
- **Page:** white background, one centered column up to 1120px wide, 48px above and 32px at the sides.
- **Headings:** "Billing" is a page title in Unbounded Light capitals.
- **Plan panel:** a card showing "Team plan", "$24" with "per seat per month" beside it, "18 of 25 seats used" and a "Change Plan" button. I added a thin seat-usage bar, which you didn't ask for.
- **Invoices:** a second card with the table, using the specified header row, 52px rows, dividers and "Paid" pills.
- **Styling:** colors, spacing and sizes all come from the tokens, with no raw hex values in the component styles.

The button is the one primary pill on the screen, and it sits inside the plan panel as you specified, so the top row holds only the title. I inlined `tokens.css` into a `<style>` block to keep the file self-contained. No font files exist in the folder, so Unbounded and Archivo fall back to the system sans-serif.
